textbookBox.concept: Three-fourths of the earth's surface is covered with water, but only a small share is fresh water that can be used. It comes from surface run-off and groundwater, renewed by the hydrological cycle.

beats.en: Water scarcity is caused by growing population, unequal access, and over-use for irrigation, industry and cities. It is also made worse by pollution.
